subject.name: Recreational vehicle service technicians
subject.summary: Recreational vehicle service technicians inspect, diagnose, and repair the electrical, gas, water supply, HVAC, chassis, and body systems of travel trailers and other recreational vehicles. The work starts with a customer repair request and work order and finishes after isolating hazards, checking manuals and taking measurements, making the repair, function retesting, recording, and handover explanation; gas, electrical, and brake problems beyond training or authorization must be stopped and escalated.
